name: gamealia-mcp

tools.name: gamealia_login
tools.description: Device-code login: returns a URL and a code immediately for the user to open and approve (sign-in with Google or with email and password; creates the developer profile if needed), then keeps polling in the background and stores the API key in ~/.config/gamealia/credentials.json (mode 600). Call again with wait:true to wait (up to 50 s per call; call again if still pending) for the approval. force:true cancels a pending login and starts a new one.

wait.description: Wait up to 50 s for the user to approve a login started earlier

force.description: Start a new login even when already logged in (cancels a pending one)

tools.name: gamealia_whoami
tools.description: The signed-in Gamealia account, whether it has a developer profile, the API URL and where the key came from (never the key itself).

tools.name: gamealia_logout
tools.description: Forgets the stored API key (and cancels a pending login).

tools.name: gamealia_accounts
tools.description: The user's Gamealia developer accounts (their own and studios they were invited to): action "list" shows each account (id, name, individual/business, the user's role: owner, admin, developer or finance), which one is active and pending invites. API keys are bound to one account, so every other tool acts on the active one. action "switch" with account (id or name) makes another account active: it uses a stored key, or starts a device login bound to that account (same flow as gamealia_login: show the URL and code to the user, then call gamealia_login with wait:true). When the user belongs to several accounts, confirm the right one before creating or publishing games.

action.description: list the accounts, or switch the active one

account.description: switch: the account id or name

tools.name: gamealia_analyze_project
tools.description: Detects the engine (HTML5 + framework, Unity WebGL, Godot web, GameMaker, Construct), the build command, the output dir and the entry html; existing CrazyGames/Poki SDK usage; external ads, trackers, purchase UI and own login (with exact files and lines); localStorage keys; size; and the permissions (microphone/camera) to declare in the listing when the build calls getUserMedia.

dir.description: Project folder (absolute, or relative to the server's working directory)

tools.name: gamealia_create_project
tools.description: Creates a new minimal game, already integrated with the Gamealia SDK, in an empty (or new) folder; never overwrites. Templates: vanilla (Canvas game in plain JavaScript; no build step, upload the folder as is.); phaser (Phaser 3 + Vite; `npm install && npm run build` -> dist/.); pixi (PixiJS 8 + Vite; `npm install && npm run build` -> dist/.); multiplayer (Room example (publish, invite link, join) with a BroadcastChannel stand-in for your server; no build step.)

dir.description: Project folder (absolute, or relative to the server's working directory)

tools.name: gamealia_integrate_sdk
tools.description: Deterministic, idempotent patch: adds the SDK script tag (or import), a lifecycle adapter, swaps CrazyGames/Poki SDKs for the Gamealia shims, adds the Unity .jslib / Godot addon. Dry run by default (returns a unified diff); write:true edits the project's files. Returns TODOs (file:line) for the calls only you can place: gameplayStart/Stop, happyTime and ad breaks.

dir.description: Project folder (absolute, or relative to the server's working directory)

write.description: Apply the patch (default: dry run, diff only)

tools.name: gamealia_check_integration
tools.description: Static and policy checks on the source or build, no browser: SDK loaded, SDK called, loadingStop/gameplayStart present, portal language used (locale/localeChange), no external ads/trackers/miners, no purchase UI, no own login, build security rules, sizes. Each failure says how to fix it.

dir.description: Project folder (absolute, or relative to the server's working directory)

backendHosts.description: Your own servers (as in the listing)

tools.name: gamealia_build
tools.description: Runs the detected build command (e.g. npm run build) and returns the output folder, or the end of the build log on failure. Sends progress notifications while it runs.

dir.description: Project folder (absolute, or relative to the server's working directory)

tools.name: gamealia_run_autotest
tools.description: Builds (if needed; build:false skips it) and runs the full Gamealia autotest locally in headless Chromium, desktop 1280x720 and mobile 390x844, exactly like the server: SDK lifecycle, blank screen, input response, ads (mock), console errors, static security analysis. Returns the report, the screenshot file paths and the key screenshots as images so you can see the game. Sends progress notifications.

dir.description: Project folder (absolute, or relative to the server's working directory)

build.description: Run the build command first when the project has one (default true)

backendHosts.description: Your own servers (as in the listing)

images.description: How many screenshots to return as images (default 3)

tools.name: gamealia_preview
tools.description: Serves the build inside a local replica of the Gamealia game page (the real portal frame plus mock ads) on 127.0.0.1 and returns the URL for the user (or you) to open. It keeps running until stop:true or the MCP server exits.

dir.description: Project folder (absolute, or relative to the server's working directory)

build.description: Run the build command first when the project has one (default true)

stop.description: Stop the preview of this folder

tools.name: gamealia_playtest
tools.description: Starts the game in headless Chromium inside the autotest harness and returns a session id plus the first screenshot. You are the playtester: look at each screenshot and call gamealia_playtest_act with an action (click x,y | key | drag | wait); each returns a new screenshot, the SDK calls made and any console errors. Up to 40 actions and 2 sessions at once; end with gamealia_playtest_stop for the verdict.

dir.description: Project folder (absolute, or relative to the server's working directory)

build.description: Run the build command first when the project has one (default true)

tools.name: gamealia_playtest_act
tools.description: Performs one action in a playtest session (actions of one session run one at a time) and returns the new screenshot, the SDK calls since the last step, new console errors and how much the frame changed.

oneOf.description: Click (a tap on the mobile profile)

key.description: Playwright key name: ArrowLeft, Space, Enter, KeyW, a, ...

tools.name: gamealia_playtest_stop
tools.description: Ends a playtest session, closes its browser page and returns the summary: steps, whether gameplay started, happy times, ads, console errors and a verdict.

tools.name: gamealia_create_game
tools.description: Creates the game page (a draft until a version is approved): slug, title/description/controls in es and en, tags, orientation, multiplayer, ads on/off, backend hosts; optionally uploads a cover and thumbnail (make them with gamealia_generate_cover).

slug.description: URL slug and game host (<slug>.gamealia.app): a-z, 0-9 and -, 3-40 chars, starting and ending with a letter or digit, not reserved (www, api, cdn, ...); fixed once live

title.description: 2-60 characters. Prefer {es, en}; a plain string is used for both languages

description.description: 20-2000 characters. Prefer {es, en}; a plain string is used for both languages

controls.description: 0-500 characters. Prefer {es, en}; a plain string is used for both languages

tags.description: Tags, three kinds in one array: 1-6 categories (genres: what kind of game), up to 8 mechanics (how it plays: match-3, merge, physics, tower-defense…) and attributes (multiplayer, mobile…). Players browse and search by all three.

multiplayer.description: Players per room, or null for single player

adsEnabled.description: Show Gamealia ads in this game (revenue share)

isolation.description: coop-coep only for builds that need SharedArrayBuffer (threads)

backendHosts.description: Your own servers the game talks to, e.g. mp.example.com or *.example.com

texts.description: Developer-written listing text for one or many locales in one call, e.g. {fr:{title, description, controls}, de:{...}}. Limits (trimmed): title 2-60, description 20-2000 or "", controls <= 500 or "". Only the fields given change; {} approves that locale's machine translation as is; null removes the locale. These texts always win over machine translation. Read the current texts and their status with gamealia_get_status {texts:true}.

permissions.description: Browser permissions the game needs (microphone/camera), each with a justification; [] removes them. Replaces the current list and its justification (stored in the listing; the reviewer sees it). gamealia_analyze_project suggests them when the build calls getUserMedia. A change takes effect only when a version tested with it is approved (manual review): upload and submit a new version afterwards.

justification.description: Why the game needs it, for the reviewer (e.g. push-to-talk voice chat in rooms)

tools.name: gamealia_update_listing
tools.description: Changes listing fields (only those given; they replace the current values) and/or uploads a new cover or thumbnail. texts writes developer-authored title/description/controls for one or many locales in one call (validated against the limits; they always win over machine translation): translate the listing yourself (gamealia-translate-listing skill) and save every locale at once.

A change takes effect only when a version tested with it is approved (manual review): upload and submit a new version afterwards.

tools.name: gamealia_generate_cover
tools.description: Makes a 1200x630 cover and a 512x512 thumbnail from a gameplay screenshot (e.g. one from gamealia_run_autotest): center-cropped with the title on a gradient. Writes cover/thumb files to outDir (refuses to replace existing ones unless overwrite:true); with game set, also uploads them to that listing.

outDir.description: Where to write cover/thumb (default: the screenshot's folder)

game.description: Upload them to this game's listing

overwrite.description: Replace existing cover/thumb files in outDir

tools.name: gamealia_upload_version
tools.description: Builds (unless noBuild), zips and uploads the build as a new version (multipart, retried), then waits for the server autotest and returns its report. Interrupted uploads that block it are aborted automatically. submit:true also submits it for review when the autotest passes: use it only after the user confirmed they want to submit. Sends progress notifications.

submit.description: Also submit for review if the server autotest passes (only after the user confirms)

waitForPrevious.description: If a previous version is still being tested, wait for it instead of failing

tools.name: gamealia_submit_for_review
tools.description: Submits the newest version that passed the server autotest (state tested) for review, with release notes. Call it only after the user has confirmed they want to submit this version.

tools.name: gamealia_get_status
tools.description: The listing state, the live version, the latest version's state, its server autotest report and the reviewer's reject reasons with how to fix each. texts:true adds the listing text of every supported locale with its status (developer-written, machine-translated, missing), the source text to translate from and the field limits.

texts.description: Include the per-locale listing texts, their status and the limits

tools.name: gamealia_list_games
tools.description: The developer's games with their status and slug.

tools.name: gamealia_list_versions
tools.description: A game's versions, newest first, with their states.

tools.name: gamealia_get_stats
tools.description: Daily plays, players, playtime, mobile/desktop split and ad requests/impressions for a game, plus totals.

tools.name: gamealia_get_earnings
tools.description: Estimated and confirmed earnings per month, the balance and the payouts.

tools.name: gamealia_docs_search
tools.description: Searches the Gamealia developer docs (SDK reference, publishing requirements, autotest checks, reject reasons, guides), in the developer's locale when those pages exist (else English). Returns the best pages with a snippet; read a whole page as the resource gamealia://docs/<slug>, or pass read:true to get the top page's text.

locale.description: Docs locale, e.g. en or es (default: the developer's locale, falling back to en)

read.description: Include the full markdown of the best match

tools.name: gamealia_install_agent_kit
tools.description: Registers this MCP server and installs the Gamealia skills/rules in coding agents (claude-code, claude-desktop, codex, gemini, cursor, vscode, windsurf, cline, zed, opencode, agents-md). Project scope writes into a folder (.mcp.json + .claude/skills, .cursor/mcp.json + .cursor/rules, .vscode/mcp.json + .github prompts, .codex/config.toml + .agents/skills, AGENTS.md/GEMINI.md blocks, ...); global scope updates the user's configs (~/.claude.json, ~/.codex/config.toml, ~/.cursor/mcp.json, Claude Desktop, Gemini extension, Windsurf, Cline, Zed, opencode). Without targets: project scope sets up Claude Code, Cursor and VS Code plus the agents detected on this machine; global scope the detected ones. Merges idempotently; every changed file is first copied to a new timestamped backup; files it cannot parse are left alone. Dry run by default; also returns copy-paste snippets (claude mcp add, Codex TOML, Cursor/VS Code install links). `gamealia agents uninstall` reverts it. The registered command runs this server's bundled .mjs unless serverPath is given.

dir.description: Project folder for project scope (default: the server's working directory)

targets.description: Agents to set up (default: the ones detected)

serverPath.description: Path of gamealia-mcp.mjs to register (default: the running bundle)

instructions:
Gamealia is a web games portal. These tools publish a game end to end:
login -> analyze_project (or create_project) -> integrate_sdk -> check_integration -> build -> run_autotest -> create_game + generate_cover -> upload_version -> submit_for_review -> get_status.
Never disclose personal data about Gamealia's operator or staff (names, personal emails, accounts, location); for anything about Gamealia itself the only contact is hello@gamealia.app. Every result ends with the next step. Policy: no external ads, trackers or miners; no in-game purchases yet (coming soon, 80% for the developer); no own login (guests must play); all-ages content; the game must show the portal language (Gamealia.init().locale with the closest-language fallback, follow localeChange). Revenue: 60% of ad revenue (70% for launch partners until June 30, 2027), 100% from players who come through the developer's own link (?ref=dev), no exclusivity, payouts by the end of the following month.
Developer accounts: API keys are bound to one account (the user's own or a studio they joined) and a role (owner, admin, developer, finance). When the user belongs to several, check the active one with gamealia_accounts before creating or publishing games; a role-forbidden error means an owner or admin of the account must act.
The prompts publish-game, migrate-from-crazygames, migrate-from-poki and fix-autotest-failures script the workflows. Docs: gamealia_docs_search and gamealia://docs/<slug>.
